hints: A vector in polar form $(r, \theta)$ has rectangular form $\langle r\cos\theta, r\sin\theta \rangle$.
Use exact values: $\cos 240^\circ = - \frac{1}{2}$, $\sin 240^\circ = - \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$.
solution_steps_latex: Apply the polar-to-rectangular conversion: $\vec{v} = \langle r\cos\theta, r\sin\theta \rangle$.
